limitations: The dataset is hand-authored simulation, not captured agent behaviour. No agent was run to produce it.
It has 48 cases, of which 33 are labelled. Accuracy on 33 cases has a wide confidence interval; the interval is reported.
Three of the four agent types (python, web, file) never appear in the training data. Anything the model gets right there is extrapolation, not learned cross-agent behaviour.
Fifteen cases are outside the trained taxonomy by design. They are coverage gaps, not model errors, and are excluded from accuracy.
The taxonomy has four classes and no class for tool execution failures, so a third of this dataset cannot be scored at all.
The dataset is never used for tuning. Improving these numbers by editing features would turn the measurement into a training set.
